result.summary: Rework 01f of docs/design/M2AUTH-accounts-tenancy-backup.md (base 043c612) by the pass-2 findings P1, P2 and ORCH's answers R1-R4. P1: the common-password list is the module app/server/auth/common-passwords.js (one frozen export COMMON_PASSWORDS, imported by password.js, no fs read; header with source, commit and the full MIT text), everywhere (C20, §3, 4.9.2, PW-4, A21, B6, §17); import-boundaries IB-1 stays unchanged and green. P2: the admin's users row is never locked at login; the per-address login_delays row is locked (insert … on conflict do nothing, then select … for update); ordinary accounts lock their users row by id after an unlocked read; new pg case AUTH-RACE-4 (six wrong admin logins from six addresses do not delay a right login from a seventh clean address: 200 within 4 s); M52 restated against the delay row, M52b (the admin users row locked) added. R1 capacity on 1 vCPU (about 7 parallel logins in 4 s, then 503) in 4.9.2, §7 and the post-deploy record; R2 full MIT notice; R3 traces run over the list before the commit (sub-step B6); R4 the deadline answer is switched off once COMMIT is sent, with an ADD-2 case. 32 of 32 criteria mapped; 62 mutants; no open question (О15, О16 answered by decisions/0137 Addition 2).
